PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JANUARY 22, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

Kevin Scott, President  Gina Maguire, Commissioner
Gloria Cordero, Vice President  Al Austin II, Commissioner
Charles Parkin, Secretary

B. Anatole Falagán, General Manager  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney

  SPECIAL MEETING

 MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT EMAIL WRITTEN COMMENTS TO
  COMMISSION@LBUTILITIES.ORG

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

CONSENT CALENDAR

1.  26-53989  Recommendation to approve January 8, 2026 Board meeting minutes.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-54067  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute contracts, and all
  documents necessary, including any necessary amendments, with Manhattan
  Stitching Company, Inc., a California corporation; High Pressure Designs LLC, a
  California limited liability corporation; and L&S Uniforms Inc., dba United Apparel &
  Promos, a New York corporation, for apparel with embroidery and screen print, in
  an annual amount not to exceed $200,000, for a period of two years, with the
  option to renew for three additional one-year periods, at the discretion of the
  General Manager.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-54068  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute contracts, and all
  documents necessary, including subsequent amendments, with Arakelian
  Enterprises, Inc., a California corporation; Consolidated Disposal Service LLC, a
  Delaware limited liability corporation; and EDCO Transport Services, LLC, a
  California corporation, for municipal solid waste processing and disposal services,
  in an aggregate annual amount not to exceed $100,000 across all three vendors,
  for a period of one year, with the option to renew for two additional one-year
  periods, at the discretion of the General Manager.

  Page 1 of 3
   PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JANUARY 22, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-54074  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute all documents
  necessary to amend the existing contract with Sully-Miller Contracting Co. for as-
  needed asphalt concrete and related materials by increasing the authorized
  amount for the initial two-year term and any optional one-year renewal periods by
  $100,000, for a revised base-term total of $510,000, and a revised annual amount
  of $305,000 for any optional renewal period.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Utilities Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Board.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

CLOSED SESSION

26-54066  Pending Litigation – closed session conference with legal counsel relating to liability claims
  pursuant to subparagraph (2) of subdivision (d) of Section 54956.9 of the California
  Government Code: Government Tort Claim of Daniel and Teresa Lim (C25-00137).

26-54065  Pursuant to Section 54957.6 of the California Government Code regarding salary and
  compensation: General Manager.

ADJOURNMENT

I, Dynna Long, Executive Assistant to the Board, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72
hours prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, or if you need the agenda provided in an alternate format, please call the Board
of Public Utilities Commissioners Executive Assistant at (562) 570-2435 or (562) 570-6626
(telecommunications for the deaf) by 12 noon, the day prior to the meeting.
